versions.description_html:
Learn what Windows Autopatch is, how it solves monthly update chores, where Intune fits in, and how deployment rings work in this clear, jargon-free guide.

Every company that runs Windows is stuck with the same unpaid chore: patching hundreds of machines, every month, forever. Most IT teams don't fall behind because they're careless, they fall behind because that job never actually ends.

In this episode of Simply Explained you will learn:
  • What It Actually Is
  • The Problem It Solves
  • Where Intune Fits In
  • The Rings
  • The Groups
  • Readiness Checks
  • The Reports
  • What It Updates
  • Who Gets It
  • The Benefits
  • What It Doesn't Do
  • The Short Version

Simply Explained by M365.FM breaks down Microsoft 365, Azure and modern IT topics in clear, jargon-free language. Hosted by Mirko Peters.
